meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检测你已有的 OpenClaw 安装,读取身份、频道凭据、定时任务等配置,逐块和你商量后再迁到 NanoClaw v2,应用前先展示改动,不静默复制数据。
howto.when: 当你提到「migrate from openclaw」「openclaw migration」等关键词,或要求从 OpenClaw 导入时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 先做发现,列出可迁移内容再逐阶段确认

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义路径,用 --state-dir 迁移
say.note: 把自定义路径传给发现脚本

say.text: 先只迁移主要 agent,其他群组稍后再加

howto.what_en: It detects your existing OpenClaw install, reads identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and config, then guides a step-by-step migration to NanoClaw v2, showing proposed changes before applying, never copying silently.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw", or when you ask to import an OpenClaw install.

say_en.text: Migrate me from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Runs discovery, lists what can move, then confirms each phase

say_en.text: My OpenClaw is at a custom path, migrate using --state-dir
say_en.note: Passes the custom path to the discovery script

say_en.text: Just migrate the primary agent for now, other groups later
say_en.note: One of the three Phase 1 options
